desc:
Welcome to Shrink To Survive Tower! 🤩

👍 Like the game and join the group

When the game starts, you'll be either a hider or a seeker. Hiders can shrink down tiny to hide anywhere in the tower. But if you are a seeker, use your rocket launcher to eliminate the hiders.

Invite your friends to get even more fun! 🤗
Play with friends for FREE on our free private servers! 🎮

This game is INSPIRED by Shrink Hide & Seek from shrinking studios.
